cron.title: Cron
cron.about: Routines and commands by time. A task is a chain of steps: a routine or a command, in one project or in all of them. Chains run one at a time, without an open page — as long as the panel is running.
cron.empty: No tasks yet. «Maintain all projects» prepares a chain: the base routines in every project at 20:00.
cron.no_detail: Run not found — the history keeps the last sixty.
cron.order_projects: by project: finish one project, then the next
cron.order_steps: by step: the first step everywhere, then the second
cron.fail_next: a step failed — carry on with the chain
cron.fail_stop: a step failed — the chain stops
cron.delete_ask: Delete the task «{name}»? Its run history stays.
cron.stop_ask: Stop the chain? The current step is interrupted, what was done up to here is saved, the remaining steps will not run.
cron.missed_line: The run at {when} was missed: the panel was not running then.
cron.note.no_project: the project is not among those the panel found
cron.note.busy: the project was busy with other work for two hours
cron.note.chain_stopped: the chain stopped: the previous step failed
cron.note.panel_restart: the panel was restarted in the middle of the step
cron.note.no_route: the routine is no longer in the scenarios
cron.note.engine_behind: the project engine is behind the kit — update the project
cron.note.found: ran and found things to fix
cron.err.bad_task: The task could not be read
cron.err.no_name: Name the task: the history is searched by name
cron.err.bad_date: The one-off date could not be read
cron.err.bad_project: The project is not among those the panel found
cron.err.bad_command: The panel does not run this command
cron.err.bad_flag: The command has no such flag
cron.err.bad_step: A step could not be read
cron.err.queued: This task is already running or queued
cron.bot_cron_hint: The cron expression from the bot file: minute hour day month weekday
cron.bot_cron_bad: the schedule has an error — fix it in «Bots»
cron.note.after_failure: the project is deferred: its previous step failed — the chain comes back to it at the end
cron.note.after_retry_failure: the retry did not help: the project's previous step failed again
cron.note.stall: the route did not move the base by a single commit — coming back at the end
cron.note.failed: the step failed — coming back at the end
cron.note.offline: model gateways did not answer — coming back at the end
cron.missed_running: at {when} the same task was still running — a second run was not started
cron.all_bots: all enabled bots of the project
cron.err.bad_bot: The project has no such bot
cron.other_panel: Another panel on this machine runs the schedule (process {pid}): tasks are visible here, but they run only there. Close that panel — this one takes over the schedule by itself within five minutes.
cron.err.other_panel: Another panel on this machine runs the schedule — start the chain there
